proposals.title: OPDS CBR MIME aliases and a feed regression fixture
proposals.basis: Open issue #15844 requests two CBR MIME aliases. At the reviewed commit, PdfDocument registers application/vnd.comicbook-rar and application/vnd.rar; the reported application/vnd.comicbook+rar and application/x-cbr aliases are absent from that registration block. DocumentRegistry maps registered MIME values to extensions.
acceptance_criteria: All four MIME aliases resolve to CBR through the document registry.
A local OPDS feed fixture exposes a download action for each alias.
Existing CBZ acquisition behavior passes the same regression check.
limitations: Source inspection and an upstream report do not establish the full OPDS UI failure at this commit; trace feed logic and reproduce first.
Duplicate search examined six of 47 issue results for mime; related PRs and all comments were not exhausted.

proposals.title: Configurable Markdown export metadata and header presentation
proposals.basis: Open issues #14885 and #13321 request cleaner exported metadata and formatting. The inspected Markdown template hardcodes author, chapter, page, timestamp and separator presentation. Style and custom formatter strings already exist.
acceptance_criteria: Page and timestamp visibility can be configured independently.
A blockquote-oriented preset handles multiline quotations, absent notes and Unicode.
Default settings preserve the existing export output.
limitations: This extends existing Markdown export, not an absent feature.
Export-title duplicate search examined 12 of 13 open issue results; proposed output fixtures were not executed.

proposals.title: Hierarchical chapter context in annotation exports
proposals.basis: Open issue #12480 requests ancestor TOC context. The inspected template emits a single entry.chapter at one heading level. Current source already includes highlight-color filtering despite another open request mentioning that capability.
acceptance_criteria: Annotations in a three-level TOC fixture retain their ancestor chapter context.
Older annotations without hierarchical metadata retain a readable fallback.
The parser and annotation model are inspected before choosing storage or migration changes.
limitations: The annotation parser and complete metadata model were not inspected; the storage change is undecided.
Do not re-request color filtering as absent. Issue search was first-page bounded and no export fixture was run.

proposals.title: Profile and reduce foliate cold-open and indexing cost
proposals.basis: Open issue #1692 reports loading regressions in Librera Pro 10.0.35. The reviewed FoliateRenderer and FoliateDocument expose open/index timing, profiling, page indexing and read-ahead boundaries suitable for a measured investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Measure cold and warm open-to-first-readable-page latency on a fixed device, EPUB corpus and layout configuration.
Measure indexing latency separately from initial display latency.
Promote an optimization only when layout, reading anchors and navigation remain equivalent.
limitations: No latency measurement or regression reproduction was performed; the report concerns an earlier version than the source pin.
The foliate issue search examined six of six results, including a separate LibreraX report; other queries and PRs were not exhausted.

proposals.title: Foliate font discovery, weight and justification conformance
proposals.basis: Issue #1692 reports font filtering, bold-weight and Turkish justification concerns. FoliateCss rewrites local font URLs, supplies fallback families and adapts layout rules. Issue #1691 concerns LibreraX and is not evidence of the same implementation defect.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise regular-only fonts, genuine bold faces, variable fonts and large headings.
Preserve authored strong/bold emphasis without applying bold indiscriminately to body text.
Compare Turkish justified-text fixtures under both relevant engines after tracing actual font discovery.
limitations: The reporter's font-filtering diagnosis is unverified; font discovery was not traced end to end.
LibreraX is a separate product. No rendering or font fixtures were executed in this source-only review.

proposals.title: Exact-position persistence across layout and lifecycle changes
proposals.basis: Old open issue #672 describes percentage-based position drift across screen sizes. Current source already has CFI location contracts; FoliateDocument deliberately returns a miss rather than blocking on main-thread location calls. Caller behavior needs focused verification.
acceptance_criteria: Restore the same text after rotation, font changes, backgrounding and device-size migration.
Identify which save/restore callers fall back to percentage and whether they lose a previously valid anchor.
If needed, retain a nonblocking last-known CFI without making main-thread WebView calls wait.
limitations: Current Librera does not lack CFI support; the old report is not proof of a current regression.
All callers and cross-device sync paths were not reviewed or exercised.

proposals.title: Current build-flavor and rendering-engine capability documentation
proposals.basis: The README's frozen-development notice coexists with a 10.1.14 commit and build configuration for PDFium, foliate and MuPDF-free JS variants. A dated flavor matrix would make documented capabilities easier to interpret.
acceptance_criteria: Document maintainer-approved current maintenance/support status without misrepresenting the war notice.
Map MuPDF, PDFium and foliate capabilities across F-Droid, Pro and JS variants.
Identify minimum API and GMS/network-dependent features with links to the corresponding build/source definitions.
limitations: No claim of abandonment, licensing violation or identical behavior across variants is made.
Published-build parity and maintainer willingness to update the documentation were not established.

proposals.title: Page-preserving PDF mode or explicit PDF capability messaging
proposals.basis: Open issue #117 requests showing PDF pages without parsing. The inspected PdfContentParser uses PDFBox text extraction to produce paragraph/separator nodes rather than original PDF page rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Provide original-page handling for scanned or layout-sensitive PDFs if that direction is accepted, or explicitly communicate the text-only boundary.
Exercise two-column, image-only, table and mixed-script PDFs.
Keep original-page rendering distinct from reflowable ebook layout and parser-version invalidation.
limitations: The maintainer explicitly declines code PRs; contribute a suggestion, reproducer or translation rather than an unsolicited implementation.
PDF issue search examined six of 27 results. No PDF fixture or full implementation absence search was run.

proposals.title: Android Open With and share import
proposals.basis: Open issue #310 requests VIEW/SEND handling. The inspected MainActivity manifest has MAIN/LAUNCHER only, while FileSystemRepositoryImpl already provides a metadata/cover ingestion path.
acceptance_criteria: Supported content URIs received from a file manager or mail share enter the existing library-import flow.
Temporary read grants and source lifetime are handled before deferred import.
Duplicate import and cancellation preserve existing library records.
limitations: A source-manifest observation is not a merged APK-manifest or on-device resolver test.
The maintainer declines code PRs; use the existing issue for a proposal or reproducible evidence.

proposals.title: Reconcile Markdown support claims with import dispatch
proposals.basis: README advertises seven extensions including Markdown. ExtensionsData, FileParserImpl and ContentParserImpl enumerate six without Markdown. The historical Markdown request #93 is closed, which does not establish present support.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm whether Markdown omission is intentional for this revision or rewrite.
If supported, demonstrate discovery, import and rendering with a small Markdown fixture.
Otherwise correct documentation to list the six implemented extension gates.
limitations: The maintainer declines code PRs; clarify intended behavior through the supported suggestion/report route.
Two of two Markdown issue results were read, including closed #93; no runtime import or branch-history investigation was performed.

proposals.title: Occurrence-aware Moon import anchors across text nodes
proposals.basis: The mrexpt parser retains b4/b5/b6 and text length, but the inspected conversion loop locates the first match in individual DOM text nodes rather than using offsets to choose a repeated occurrence. Existing Moon import is UI-wired.
acceptance_criteria: Verify offset and chapter semantics against lawful Moon+ v10.8 exports before using them as location hints.
Repeated phrases within and across chapters resolve to the intended occurrence or expose ambiguity.
Phrases split by inline elements, CJK text and whitespace changes preserve intended range boundaries or report a bounded fallback.
limitations: No v10.8 export was tested; offsets are not certified portable across editions.
The mrexpt issue query returned zero and Moon returned 38 with ten examined; this is not an exhaustive issue/PR novelty check.

proposals.title: Moon import fidelity and visible reconciliation outcomes
proposals.basis: The parser does not retain the raw marker/color value; conversion applies one chosen style/color and returns unmatched/total. The inspected Annotator success path reports added/updated counts without those reconciliation values. Duplicate/no-op reimport and deletion resurrection already exist.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve color and style distinctions where verified export data permits a reliable mapping.
Report exact matches, chapter-start fallbacks, skipped entries and ambiguity separately.
Make partial-import outcomes reviewable while preserving existing duplicate/no-op, newer-note and deletion-resurrection behavior.
limitations: This extends a real importer; neither a missing-importer claim nor full v10.8 compatibility is established.
Existing merge tests were read, not executed. Import-related issue and PR searches were bounded.

proposals.title: Stronger publisher CSS and layout preservation option
proposals.basis: Open issue #7417 requests Force Book Layout. The inspected style assembly always includes page/image CSS while useBookLayout skips only paragraph CSS; FoliateViewer applies the assembled styles.
acceptance_criteria: A synthetic EPUB with authored img width of 50 percent keeps that width in a publisher-first mode.
Functional link, footnote and overflow behavior remains correct.
Verify the option in Chromium, Android WebView and WebKit with both paginated and scrolled reading.
limitations: Reporter measurements are upstream-report evidence, not independently collected results.
No browser or device fixture was run; related PRs and the complete stylesheet interaction surface were not exhausted.

proposals.title: Interoperable annotated PDF export
proposals.basis: Open issue #7572 requests standard annotations embedded in an exported PDF. The inspected annotation data flow and BaseAppService.saveFile provide input/output seams. Overlay annotations and JSON/Markdown exports are different capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Export a new PDF containing standard highlights and notes that reopen in two independent readers.
Preserve annotation geometry with cropped and rotated pages.
Treat flattening as an explicit separate option and retain the original file.
limitations: A complete repository-wide PDF-writeback absence check was not performed; confirm implementation and related PRs before coding.
No annotated PDF was exported or cross-reader-tested.

proposals.title: Readable Library filter chips at large text and display scaling
proposals.basis: Open GitLab issue #90 supplies Android 9 emulator comparisons at 1080 by 1920 pixels: density 540/fontScale 1.3 versus 420/1.0. Current pinned XML still uses equal-weight 0dp chip widths and fixed margins for Completed and Abandoned.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce the reported scaling combination and baseline before changing layout.
Keep Completed, Abandoned and long translations readable at large scale and narrow window widths without shrinking user-selected text.
Preserve unambiguous selection, keyboard focus and accessibility labels after any wrapping or scrolling change.
limitations: The emulator observations belong to the upstream reporter; this review did not render the layout.
GitLab duplicate review examined the newest returned open-issue page only; related merge requests were not exhausted.

proposals.title: Text-mode read-aloud with synchronized highlighting
proposals.basis: The pinned roadmap lists improved Text Mode and TTS with synchronized highlighting for v3.7. TextModeContentLoader and PdfExtractor provide incremental extraction and native-page ownership seams.
acceptance_criteria: Start, pause and resume narration with sentence-level highlighting.
Handle page jumps and activity close without leaked handles or competing extraction ownership.
Begin narration without extracting every document page first.
limitations: This is a documented roadmap enhancement, not a missing-feature conclusion from an exhaustive implementation search.
No TTS, lifecycle or native-handle test was executed.

proposals.title: Structured study exports beyond existing plain text
proposals.basis: The roadmap lists Markdown, Anki, Obsidian and flashcard exports for v3.8. AnnotationListLogic centralizes export data, and both UserHighlightsActivity and UserNotesActivity already expose SAF plain-text export.
acceptance_criteria: Retain stable document, page and annotation identifiers with separate quoted text and user notes.
Preserve color and TOC context and make repeated exports deterministic.
Exercise escaping, multiline Unicode and annotations created by independent PDF tools.
limitations: Plain-text export is already implemented; this proposal adds interoperable structured output.
No exports were executed and candidate-specific merge-request deduplication remains incomplete.

proposals.title: Large-screen multi-document tabs with isolated lifecycle
proposals.basis: Open GitLab issue #88 requests tabs in one view and the roadmap's v3.3 entry discusses large screens and possible tabs. Separate Android instances already exist. Extractor/loader ownership is relevant to tab resource isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Switch between several PDFs while retaining independent page, zoom and unsaved annotation state.
Closing a tab releases its native resources without disrupting other tabs.
Specify and verify process restoration and bounded memory use with large files.
limitations: In-window tabs are distinct from existing multiple-instance behavior.
No tablet, restoration or memory test was run; tab architecture and maintainer acceptance remain undecided.

proposals.title: Separate no-link from valid page index zero
proposals.basis: MuPDFCore.resolveLink returns a document page number; PageView returns it for internal links but also uses zero for external/no-link outcomes. ReaderView.onSingleTapUp follows only page > 0, making a valid index-zero destination indistinguishable in that path.
acceptance_criteria: A three-page PDF follows links from page 3 to page 1/index 0 and page 2/index 1.
Navigation history returns to the source page after either internal link.
External URLs and no-link taps retain distinct behavior.
limitations: This is a source-level reproduction candidate, not a confirmed on-device defect.
The link issue query returned three results (#33, #26, #1), none an exact page-zero report; this does not establish novelty across all issues or PRs.

proposals.title: Basic text selection and copy within simplified viewer scope
proposals.basis: Open issues #29 and #36 request text selection/copy. The inspected ReaderView long-press handler is empty. PageView and MuPDFCore define the relevant page/engine boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Support selection handles, clipboard copy and cancellation at multiple zoom levels.
Preserve selection geometry under page rotation.
Explain image-only PDF behavior without implying OCR, form editing or annotation editing.
limitations: This simplified viewer deliberately excludes forms and annotation editing; capabilities of the full MuPDF product are separate.
Six of 31 open issue results were examined. No selection or clipboard interaction was tested.

proposals.title: Share the currently open document
proposals.basis: Open issue #25 requests a share action. The inspected DocumentActivity intent handling and LibraryActivity SAF opening path expose the selected document URI, providing an integration seam.
acceptance_criteria: A share action passes a readable content URI and transient read grant to a receiving app.
Document-provider sources work without requiring a raw filesystem path.
Verify receiver readability and URI lifetime rather than merely showing a share sheet.
limitations: No share receiver or URI-grant lifecycle test was run.
Duplicate checking was bounded to the newest open-issue page; related PRs and complete activity/menu behavior were not exhaustively reviewed.
